title: HOOPING TRICKS TUTORIAL: A New, Easy Way To Learn The Corkscrew

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the trick into six structured, sequential steps with on-screen text instructions and demonstration. She guides the student through isolated hand motions, grip changes, and combining waist hooping with the corkscrew.

lesson_structure.note: Title card showing Learn The Corkscrew In 6 Easy Steps
Step 1: Waist hoop to find out which hand to use
Step 2: Practice the grip change without doing the corkscrew
Step 3: Step inside your hoop to practice the hand motion
Step 4: Do the corkscrew without waist hooping
Step 5: Practice getting the hand in while waist hooping

cues: Keep the hoop close to your body
Your corkscrewing hand needs to move fast
Do the hand motion even faster this time!

steps_taught.name: Corkscrew
steps_taught.description: A hoop trick involving arm and hand transition overhead while waist hooping

what_hinders: No spoken audio explanations, only text and demonstration

evidence_segments.observation: Demonstrating the full corkscrew trick with waist hooping and overhead arm movement

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the trick into six distinct micro-steps isolating grip, hand motion, and waist hooping separately.
